newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends up vs dlr, BCE fx futures trade soars.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends up vs dlr, BCE fx futures trade soars.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed firmer against the dollar on Wednesday as the U.S. unit took a breather from its recent surge.
The forint finished at 156.00/05 to one dollar, compared to an opening of 156.18/23.
"The dollar/mark cross was the only real factor in quiet trade," said Balazs Benczedi of West LB Hungaria. "I expect the same tomorrow."
The forint floats against a currency basket made up 70 percent of the Ecu and 30 percent of the dollar.

The currency futures market at the Budapest Commodity Exchange saw its highest turnover for several months at 8.88 billion forints. Dealers said high turnover was a feature of the third Wednesday of the month when customers close their positions on maturing contracts.
The Italian lira, which opened a September 1997 contract, and the yen accounted for three-quarters of trade.
The lira eased and the yen steadied. The dollar fell for most contracts while the mark fell for March and September.
